plainText:
Murdock's Lycanroc (Japanese: マードックのルガルガン Murdoch's Lugarugan) is Murdock's partner and his first known . It helps Murdock in finding various people or lost objects for the Rising Volt Tacklers. It is often seen outside its .

==In animation==
===History===
 
 ]]
 first appeared as a in The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two), when it greeted Liko and her when they arrived onboard the Brave Olivine. After greeting the , Rockruff joined in a game with Sprigatito, , and .

In For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!, Rockruff joined in the search for Liko's Sprigatito after it had been taken as a hostage by the Explorers. By using its great sense of smell, Rockruff spotted Onia when she was out shopping and alerted the other members of the Rising Volt Tacklers who gave chase. Whilst Friede distracted Amethio by battling his with Captain Pikachu, Rockruff helped Liko find and free Sprigatito.
 ready to battle]]
In Found You, Fuecoco!, Murdock used Rockruff to battle the Explorers when they confronted the Rising Volt Tacklers. It battled against Zirc and his . However, despite holding its own, Rockruff couldn't beat Zirc's Rhydon and was carried back to the ship by Murdock.

In The Bittersweet Truth, Rockruff stayed on the airship to get groomed by Mollie when Murdock, Liko, and Roy went to Motostoke to get supplies.
 ]]
In Slip and Crash! A Mystery Pokémon?!, Rockruff heard a noise as it got Liko and her Sprigatito attention, but the three didn't know where the noise was coming from. However, after Captain Pikachu and the Pokémon living on the Brave Olivine found out that a was behind the purple goo and the noise, Rockruff joined them and Terapagos in watching a battle between the Black Tea Pokémon and . Although the battled was called off, Rockruff joined its friends in welcoming Polteageist to the group with Liko's Sprigatito, Roy's Fuecoco, and Dot's Quaxly joining them.

In Lapras's Feelings for its Friends, Rockruff and Mollie's Chansey joined forces to fend off the attacking Pokémon sent by Lucius's Lapras who were trying to steal their supplies. While intimidated at first, Rockruff and Chansey nevertheless pushed through to defend their airship, with Chansey focusing on while Rockruff battled .
 
In Roar of the Black Rayquaza, Rockruff and Terapagos got together to hold a meeting with the other Pokémon inside Brave Olivine. The party continued until the group was interrupted by and soon after by Dot, who caught all the mess the Pokémon made in Murdock's kitchen.

In Reunion in Cortondo, Liko, Roy, and Dot arrived in Cortondo to find Murdock, discovering that Rockruff had evolved into Lycanroc during the one year timeskip. Murdock stated that after working for Katy, he began experimenting recipes, with Rockruff being his taste tester. Eventually, during one of these taste tests, Rockruff inexplicably evolved into Lycanroc. Due to the heavy consumption of sweets, Lycanroc became obese. Lycanroc played with the group and their Pokémon before seeing them off.

In We Are the Rising Volt Tacklers!, Lycanroc appeared alongside Murdock when he returned to the Rising Volt Tacklers. By this point, Lycanroc has slimmed down, making it appear more in-line with its species' general appearance.
 

===Personality and characteristics===
 
 
Lycanroc, while it was a Rockruff, is shown to be a playful Pokémon, as seen in The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two) when it played with Liko's Sprigatito and a few of the other Pokémon seen on the Brave Olivine. Despite its playful personality, Lycanroc is a serious Pokémon, as seen in For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!, when it joined in the search for Sprigatito. It is very eager and cannot help but restrain itself without command. Rockruff also likes to get groomed, as shown in The Bittersweet Truth, when it stayed on the Brave Olivine to get brushed by Mollie.

Lycanroc has a great relationship with Murdock as it enjoys hanging out with him. It is also shown to have a sweet tooth. Due to its heavy consumption of sweets following Murdock's employment with Katy, Lycanroc was larger and more obese than others of its kind, having a chubby face, large stomach and legs. However, prior to We Are the Rising Volt Tacklers!, Lycanroc was able to lose all the weight that it gained from eating all the sweets Murdock made. Lycanroc has become able to help Murdock carrying his supplies for the Brave Olivine, as seen in Tinkatuff's Hammer Wasn't Made in a Year!.

Whenever Murdock was cooking something or someone was snooping around the kitchen, Lycanroc would make sure its Trainer wasn't disturbed and get them to leave, as seen in The Treasure After the Storm!, as well has protecting the food supply, that would usually be sneakly eaten by Roy's Fuecoco. Like its , Lycanroc has a great sense of smell and has use it to help its Trainer and friends find something or someone. Despite being a , Lycanroc isn't bothered by water, as seen in Riding the Waves, when it went surfing with Murdock.

==In the games==
===Pokémon GO===
On March 5, 2024, as part of Pokémon GO's Pokémon Horizons: The Series Celebration Event, which was based on , several Pokémon based on those encountered in the animated series appeared more frequently in the wild, in , from Eggs, from Field Research tasks, and during surprise encounters, with Rockruff appearing in level 1 raids and from Field Research tasks. The event ran from March 5, 2024, at 10:00 a.m., to March 11, 2024, at 8:00 p.m. local time.
